paper_title: Incorporating Domain Knowledge into Materials Tokenization
caption: Comparison of Macro-F1 scores for ChemDataExtractor and MatDetector across values.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates how Macro-F1 Score (%) varies with the λ value for two systems, comparing MatDetector (ours) against ChemDataExtractor. The x-axis is labeled “λ value” on a linear categorical scale with tick labels “w/o”, then numeric values from 0.1 to 1.0 in increments of 0.1, followed by 2 and 3. The y-axis is labeled “Macro-F1 Score (%)”, uses a linear scale, and spans roughly from 72.0 to 75.5 with regularly spaced tick marks every 0.5. MatDetector (ours) is shown as a solid pink line with circular markers; it starts at about 72.6 at “w/o”, stays near 72.6–72.7 at 0.1–0.2, rises to about 73.5 at 0.3, dips to about 72.7 at 0.4, then increases to about 73.6 (0.5) and 74.1 (0.6), fluctuates around 73.7–74.2 from 0.7 to 0.9 (about 73.7 at 0.7, 74.2 at 0.8, 73.9 at 0.9), reaches its highest point near 75.6 at 1.0, drops to about 73.1 at 2, and ends around 72.4 at 3. ChemDataExtractor is shown as a dark blue dashed line with square markers; it begins near 72.6 at “w/o”, declines to about 72.3 at 0.1, returns to about 72.6 at 0.2, is about 72.4 at 0.3, rises to about 73.1 at 0.4 and 73.4 at 0.5, drops to about 72.7 at 0.6, increases to about 73.2 at 0.7, is about 73.1 at 0.8, rises to about 73.6 at 0.9 and about 73.7 at 1.0, then falls to about 73.2 at 2 and ends near 71.9 at 3.
